evidence_items.explanation: The report describes Klarna replacing Salesforce CRM with an internally developed stack and AI-enabled interfaces. This contradicts the categorical denial under the functional-replacement reading, while the CEO cautions that most companies may not follow.

Reuters links a rebound to Anthropic partnerships after AI-disruption fears had depressed the sector. This supports the narrower claim that AI expectations moved prices, but the concrete announcements weaken the suggestion that nothing actually happened.
